description.value:
You gain one of the following options of your choice.

Colossus Slayer. Your persistence grinds down even the toughest opposition. Once per turn, when you hit a creature that isn't at its full hit points with a weapon attack, you deal an extra 1d8 damage of the weapon's damage type.

Giant Killer. When a Large or larger creature within 5 feet of you hits or misses you with an attack, you can use your reaction to strike back at it immediately, provided you can see the creature.

Horde Breaker. Once on each of your turns when you make a weapon attack, you can make a second attack with that same weapon, requiring no action, against a different creature within 5 feet of the first target and within your weapon's range.
